arcaneLibrary.name: Arcane Library
arcaneLibrary.description: Select a level 4 spell to learn for 2000 gold.
arcaneLibrary.onSelectMessage: As you approach the drifting cloud, a quaint little house appears with windows that sparkle like the night sky. Inside, a magician awaits, his fingers tracing arcane symbols in the air, ready to teach you the ancient art of spellcraft... for a mere 2000 gold.
arcaneLibrary.onVisitedMessage: I have already shared my wisdom with you. When the week is complete, return and I will teach you a new spell.

message: As you approach the drifting cloud, a quaint little house appears with windows that sparkle like the night sky. Inside, a magician awaits, his fingers tracing arcane symbols in the air, ready to teach you the ancient art of spellcraft. Unfortunately, you don't have the necessary wisdom to master a new spell.
I am willing to teach you a spell but not for free. Return when you have 2000 gold to pay me.
